uin: A patient seeks official treatment duration and drug protocol for drug-sensitive pulmonary TB under NTEP. [Query Variant 28]

prompts.english: What is the standard treatment duration and regimen for drug-sensitive pulmonary tuberculosis under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Program? (Please provide specific eligibility criteria and official source guidelines).
prompts.hindi: राष्ट्रीय क्षय रोग उन्मूलन कार्यक्रम (NTEP) के तहत दवा-संवेदनशील फुफ्फुसीय टीबी के लिए मानक उपचार अवधि और आहार क्या है? (कृपया विशिष्ट पात्रता मानदंड और आधिकारिक स्रोत दिशानिर्देश प्रदान करें।)
prompts.code_switch: NTEP ke under drug-sensitive pulmonary TB ke liye standard treatment duration aur drug regimen kya hai? (Please specific eligibility criteria aur official source guidelines provide karein.)

important_facts.text: Directly Observed Treatment Short-Course (DOTS) daily fixed-dose combinations used.
Nikshay Poshan Yojana provides ₹500/month financial assistance during treatment.

optional_facts.text: Official application forms available online and offline.

prohibited_claims: Claiming false upfront fees or unauthorized third-party middleman application processes.
